title: The 5 Best Automatic Pet Feeders Under $60
h1: The 5 Best Automatic Pet Feeders Under $60
metaDescription: Our 5 picks for automatic pet feeders under $60, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at automatic pet feeders under $60 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Cat Mate C500 Digital 5-Meal Automatic Feeder
products.blurb: Key specs: 5 sealed compartments, each holding up to 3/4 lb of food, Included ice packs for wet or fresh food, Digital timer with initial feed plus 4 scheduled meals.
strengths: One of the only budget-tier feeders that genuinely handles wet food thanks to included ice packs
Manual pre-measured compartments avoid the auger-accuracy drift of pricier hopper feeders
Over a year of runtime on 3 AA batteries means minimal ongoing cost
limitations: No app or remote alerts, it's a standalone digital timer
5-meal capacity means more frequent refilling than a large dry-food hopper
No camera, so there's no way to remotely confirm a meal dispensed
features: 5 sealed compartments, each holding up to 3/4 lb of food

products.name: PETLIBRO Granary 5L Automatic Pet Feeder (Button Model)
